verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS product that collects user feedback submissions, screenshots and code context, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of retention periods, deletion of submissions, or data purge controls. API key revocation is a related credential-management feature, not data retention or deletion, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
